```python
def mask_code(code: str) -> str: # [P1, H1, H2, H3]
    if len(code) == 0: # [H2]
        return ""
    if len(code) <= 3: # [H3]
        return "*" * len(code)
    return "*" * (len(code) - 3) + code[-3:] # [H1]
```
